contents.title_tr: Aeros and Aril Partner to Increase the Indigenous Content of Air Platforms (MSI TDR)
contents.title_en: Aeros and Aril Partner to Increase the Indigenous Content of Air Platforms
contents.summary_tr: Aeros and Aril Aviation and Defence have signed a strategic cooperation agreement covering the design and production of aircraft systems, components, and test systems. Under the agreement, the two companies aim to localise certain…
contents.body_tr:
Aeros and Aril Aviation and Defence have signed a strategic cooperation agreement covering the design and production of aircraft systems, components, and test systems. Under the agreement, the two companies aim to localise certain structural components of air platforms that are currently procured from abroad.

The agreement was signed on October 15 by Serdar Çora, Chairman of the Board at Aeros, and Kutsal Eğilmez, General Manager of Aril Aviation and Defence. Providing insight into the agreement, Çora stated that the partnership is intended as a long-term collaboration between the two companies, and added: “Aril Aviation has highly advanced CNC manufacturing capabilities. On the other hand, Aeros has reached a significant level in terms of design capabilities. Through this agreement, we aim to carry out the design and production of both final and intermediate structural products for aircraft. We have specifically identified structural components sourced from abroad as target products. Our objective is to manufacture all such parts, which are produced using titanium, steel, aluminium, Inconel and Invar, domestically.”

contents.title_tr: Precision Strikes by KIZILELMA and UCAVs (MSI TDR)
contents.title_en: Precision Strikes by KIZILELMA and UCAVs
contents.summary_tr: The competence of Türkiye’s defence and aerospace industry in unmanned aerial platforms was once again demonstrated, both through Baykar’s ongoing test programme and during Exercise DENİZKURDU-I/2025 conducted by the Turkish Naval…
contents.body_tr:
The competence of Türkiye’s defence and aerospace industry in unmanned aerial platforms was once again demonstrated, both through Baykar’s ongoing test programme and during Exercise DENİZKURDU-I/2025 conducted by the Turkish Naval Forces.

As part of its ongoing test programme, Bayraktar KIZILELMA, developed by Baykar, successfully conducted live-fire trials on October 8 at the AKINCI Flight Training and Test Center in Çorlu, Tekirdağ. During the tests, the unmanned aircraft hit its targets with pinpoint accuracy using two different types of munitions. In the first sortie, the TOLUN munition developed by ASELSAN struck the target, followed by a successful strike by Roketsan’s TEBER-82 munition during the second sortie using the third prototype, PT-3. According to a statement released by Baykar, the aircraft has undergone structural and avionic improvements during its development process. Test flights have also been conducted with an afterburning engine alternative. With the integration of the new engine and aerodynamic modifications, KIZILELMA is expected to gain enhanced manoeuvrability at higher speeds and during demanding missions. It was also emphasised that the aircraft, equipped with an AESA radar, will be capable of executing missions with improved situational awareness....

A high-level delegation from Italy, including the Deputy Minister of Defence and commanders of the armed forces, visited Baykar to conduct an on-site evaluation of its unmanned aerial vehicles and the advanced technology centres where these systems are developed. contents.title_tr: Turkish Defence and Aerospace Sector’s Exports Reaches to $6 Billion in 9 Months (MSI TDR)
contents.title_en: Turkish Defence and Aerospace Sector’s Exports Reaches to $6 Billion in 9 Months
contents.summary_tr: Export figures for the defence and aerospace industry for the month of September have been announced. The sector recorded $574 million in exports during September. Total exports between January and September reached approximately $6…
contents.body_tr:
Export figures for the defence and aerospace industry for the month of September have been announced. The sector recorded $574 million in exports during September. Total exports between January and September reached approximately $6 billion, marking a 39 percent increase compared to the same period last year.

Commenting on the figures on October 2, Prof. Dr. Haluk Görgün, Secretary of the Defence Industries, stated that this growth does not merely represent a numerical achievement; it also reflects the global recognition of Turkish engineering, the domestic production ecosystem, and Türkiye’s strategic vision. He continued: “Our industrialisation policies, engineering approach in production, and emphasis on sustainability ensure that each platform we deliver is designed to meet both today’s operational needs and the requirements of the future. This vision is steadily turning our defence and aerospace industry into a lasting global actor. Through international cooperation, joint projects, and the solutions we provide across our broad geopolitical sphere, Türkiye is becoming a reliable partner in defence worldwide. The strong ties we maintain with friendly and allied nations support peace and stability, while also elevating our export performance to new heights. With original solutions in critical technologies, we will continue to work with determination for a stronger Türkiye in global competition.”...

contents.summary_tr: Harp Defence: The Sector’s Mechanical Design Solution Partner for Electronic Units
contents.summary_en: Harp Defence: The Sector’s Mechanical Design Solution Partner for Electronic Units
contents.body_tr:
Electronic units can perform reliably in the field only when they are housed in boxes, enclosures and racks with mechanical designs capable of withstanding environmental conditions. Harp Defence Systems Inc. (Harp Defence) ranks among the Turkish defence and aerospace sector’s leading solution partners in this field thanks to its design and manufacturing capabilities, extensive field experience, and proprietary products incorporating critical subcomponents such as the wedge locks developed under the Vikilit® brand. The company can provide prime contractors and system developers with turnkey solutions from design to production through a single source.

Harp Defence was established in 2017 to provide engineering solutions, from design to production, to companies and institutions operating primarily in the defence and aerospace sector, as well as in other industrial branches, with its advanced-technology products and designs. The company was founded by a team with defence and aerospace experience in computer-aided design and computer-aided engineering. Harp Defence conducts its design activities through 3D design, structural analyses covering static loads, shock, vibration and acceleration, as well as computational fluid dynamics methods. It combines these capabilities with its command of electronic cooling techniques and the experience and know-how required to offer solutions from a single source. A strategic partner of ASELSAN, Harp Defence serves leading sector companies in Türkiye and abroad.

contents.title_tr: FMK Havacılık’ın Yeni Genel Müdürü Barış Yeniçeri Oldu
contents.title_en: FMK Havacılık’ın Yeni Genel Müdürü Barış Yeniçeri Oldu
contents.summary_tr: Barış Yeniçeri, FMK Havacılık Genel Müdürü olarak göreve başladı.
contents.summary_en: Barış Yeniçeri, FMK Havacılık Genel Müdürü olarak göreve başladı.
contents.body_tr:
Firma, atamanın kurumsal yapılanmasını güçlendirme ve sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefleri doğrultusunda gerçekleştirildiğini açıkladı. Yeniçeri'nin deneyimi ve liderlik yaklaşımıyla firmanın stratejik hedeflerine katkı sağlamasının beklendiği belirtildi.

 

Barış Yeniçeri Kimdir?

Kariyerine 2001 yılında, dönemin Başbakanlık Dış Ticaret Müsteşarlığına bağlı İhracatı Geliştirme Etüd Merkezinde (İGEME) uzman olarak başlayan Barış Yeniçeri, 2010-2011 yıllarında aynı merkez bünyesinde Orta Doğu ve Körfez Dairesi Başkanı olarak görev yaptı. 2012-2016 yılları arasında ticaret ataşeliği, 2016-2018 yılları arasında ise Ticaret Bakanlığı Personel Dairesi Başkan Yardımcılığı görevlerini üstlendi.

Ağustos 2018-Ekim 2023 döneminde Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı Kalkınma Ajansları Kurucu Genel Müdürü olarak görev yapan Yeniçeri, Ekim 2023-Ağustos 2026 döneminde aynı bakanlıkta Bakanlık Müşaviri olarak çalıştı.

MSI Dergisi olarak Barış Yeniçeri’ye yeni görevinde başarılar dileriz!
contents.body_en:
Firma, atamanın kurumsal yapılanmasını güçlendirme ve sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefleri doğrultusunda gerçekleştirildiğini açıkladı. Yeniçeri'nin deneyimi ve liderlik yaklaşımıyla firmanın stratejik hedeflerine katkı sağlamasının beklendiği belirtildi.

 

Barış Yeniçeri Kimdir?

Kariyerine 2001 yılında, dönemin Başbakanlık Dış Ticaret Müsteşarlığına bağlı İhracatı Geliştirme Etüd Merkezinde (İGEME) uzman olarak başlayan Barış Yeniçeri, 2010-2011 yıllarında aynı merkez bünyesinde Orta Doğu ve Körfez Dairesi Başkanı olarak görev yaptı. 2012-2016 yılları arasında ticaret ataşeliği, 2016-2018 yılları arasında ise Ticaret Bakanlığı Personel Dairesi Başkan Yardımcılığı görevlerini üstlendi.

Ağustos 2018-Ekim 2023 döneminde Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı Kalkınma Ajansları Kurucu Genel Müdürü olarak görev yapan Yeniçeri, Ekim 2023-Ağustos 2026 döneminde aynı bakanlıkta Bakanlık Müşaviri olarak çalıştı.

MSI Dergisi olarak Barış Yeniçeri’ye yeni görevinde başarılar dileriz!

contents.title_en: STM NETA 300, Kaş Açıklarında Batık Tankı Görüntüledi
contents.summary_tr: STM tarafından geliştirilen hafif insansız otonom sualtı aracı STM NETA 300, Antalya'nın Kaş ilçesi açıklarında sualtı keşif faaliyeti gerçekleştirdi. Güvercin Adası çevresinde görev yapan araç, sonar sistemleri ve görüntüleme kabiliyetlerini kullanarak bölgede bulunan batık tankı görüntüledi.
contents.summary_en: STM tarafından geliştirilen hafif insansız otonom sualtı aracı STM NETA 300, Antalya'nın Kaş ilçesi açıklarında sualtı keşif faaliyeti gerçekleştirdi. Güvercin Adası çevresinde görev yapan araç, sonar sistemleri ve görüntüleme kabiliyetlerini kullanarak bölgede bulunan batık tankı görüntüledi.
contents.body_tr:
Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri envanterinde kullanım ömrünü tamamlayan tank, dalış turizmine katkı sağlamak ve yapay resif oluşturmak amacıyla 2017 yılında Güvercin Adası açıklarında sualtına yerleştirilmişti. STM NETA 300, gerçekleştirdiği faaliyetle sualtı keşfi, nesne tespiti ve görüntüleme kabiliyetlerini gerçek deniz koşullarında sergiledi.

STM NETA 300, 19-27 Ekim tarihlerinde düzenlenen TURNAs-2026 Millî İnsansız Deniz Sistemleri Tatbikatı'nda da görev almıştı. Araç, tatbikat kapsamında intikal rotası üzerindeki mayın ve mayın benzeri sualtı tehditlerini otonom olarak tespit ve teşhis etti. Ayrıca kritik tesislerin güvenliği ve boru hatlarının incelenmesine yönelik tarama faaliyetleri gerçekleştirdi.

300 metre derinlikte ve 24 saate kadar görev yapabilen STM NETA 300, 5 knot sürate ulaşabiliyor. İki kişi tarafından taşınabilen araç; istihbarat, keşif, gözetleme, mayın karşı tedbirleri ve liman savunması gibi askerî görevlerin yanı sıra deniz tabanı araştırmaları ve sualtı tesislerinin denetiminde de kullanılabiliyor.

STM Genel Müdürü Özgür Güleryüz, STM NETA 300'ün Akdeniz'de gerçekleştirdiği otonom keşif görevinin, firmanın sualtı teknolojilerindeki mühendislik kabiliyetlerini ortaya koyduğunu belirtti. Güleryüz, STM NETA 300'ün ardından insansız denizaltı TENGİZ ve kamikaze insansız deniz aracı STM YAKTU ile insansız deniz sistemleri ürün ailesini genişlettiklerini ifade etti.

İlk yurt içi satış sözleşmesi imzalanan STM NETA 300'ün Türk Deniz Kuvvetleri bünyesinde görev yapması planlanıyor.

contents.body_tr:
The workshop on pistol basics, organised by SARSILMAZ ACADEMY, was hosted by Poligon ARER, located in the Gebze district of Kocaeli. Held on August 9, the event provided participants with insights from SARSILMAZ’s team of experts on the fundamentals of safe and effective shooting.

The event had limited registration slots and various types of firearms and ammunition were introduced, while topics such as trigger control, aiming, and post-firing safety were addressed. The workshop included both theoretical and practical sessions, and participants were awarded certificates upon completion. SARSILMAZ officials announced that similar workshops, as well as those in different categories, will continue to be held in the coming period.

contents.title_tr: Bayraktar TB3 In Service for the Turkish Land Forces
contents.title_en: Bayraktar TB3 In Service for the Turkish Land Forces
contents.summary_tr: The Bayraktar TB3 armed unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) has officially entered the inventory of the Turkish Land Forces Command. With this delivery, the Bayraktar TB3 has, for the first time, been formally fielded
contents.summary_en: The Bayraktar TB3 armed unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) has officially entered the inventory of the Turkish Land Forces Command. With this delivery, the Bayraktar TB3 has, for the first time, been formally fielded
contents.body_tr:
The Bayraktar TB3 armed unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) has officially entered the inventory of the Turkish Land Forces Command. With this delivery, the Bayraktar TB3 has, for the first time, been formally fielded by a branch of the Turkish Armed Forces.

Sources from the Ministry of National Defence announced during a press briefing held on September 4 that the inspection and acceptance procedures for the TB3s had been completed and that the systems had been added to the inventory of the Turkish Land Forces Command. Developed by Baykar, the Bayraktar TB3 is distinguished by its foldable wing configuration and its ability to take off from and land on short runways.

contents.title_tr: Five Companies from the Turkish Defence and Aerospace Industry Among the World’s Top Defence Companies
contents.title_en: Five Companies from the Turkish Defence and Aerospace Industry Among the World’s Top Defence Companies
contents.summary_tr: The US-based Defense News magazine has released this year’s edition of its “Top 100” list, which ranks the world’s leading defence and aerospace companies. Based on the total revenues of global firms, the list includes A
contents.summary_en: The US-based Defense News magazine has released this year’s edition of its “Top 100” list, which ranks the world’s leading defence and aerospace companies. Based on the total revenues of global firms, the list includes A
contents.body_tr:
The US-based Defense News magazine has released this year’s edition of its “Top 100” list, which ranks the world’s leading defence and aerospace companies. Based on the total revenues of global firms, the list includes ASELSAN, Military Factory and Shipyard Management Inc. (ASFAT), Mechanical and Chemical Industry (MKE), Roketsan, and Turkish Aerospace.

ASELSAN was the highest-ranked Turkish company on the “Top 100” list, placing 43rd after dropping one position compared to the previous year. Turkish Aerospace moved up from 50th to 47th place. Roketsan maintained its position, ranking 71st once again this year. ASFAT made a significant leap, rising from 94th to 78th. MKE also advanced in the rankings, climbing from 84th to 80th place.

Prof. Dr. Haluk Görgün, Secretary of the Defence Industries, made a statement on September 2 regarding the list. Emphasising that the Turkish defence and aerospace industry continues to strengthen its position on the global stage, Prof. Dr. Görgün said: “This success reflects the determination of our engineers, the synergy within our sector, and the trust of our nation. Our sustainable growth strategy is not only a guarantee of today’s achievements but also a pledge for tomorrow’s global leadership. The Turkish defence industry will continue to rise with its strong outlook, innovative vision, and unwavering commitment to full independence. I wholeheartedly congratulate the companies, their executives, and all personnel in the field who contributed to this remarkable achievement.”

contents.title_tr: MKE Bids to Establish a 155 mm Ammunition Production Line in Poland
contents.title_en: MKE Bids to Establish a 155 mm Ammunition Production Line in Poland
contents.summary_tr: Mechanical and Chemical Industry (MKE) participated in MSPO 2025, held in Kielce, Poland, between September 2 and 5. During the event, which was also attended by Deputy Minister of National Defence Bilal Durdalı, the com
contents.summary_en: Mechanical and Chemical Industry (MKE) participated in MSPO 2025, held in Kielce, Poland, between September 2 and 5. During the event, which was also attended by Deputy Minister of National Defence Bilal Durdalı, the com
contents.body_tr:
Mechanical and Chemical Industry (MKE) participated in MSPO 2025, held in Kielce, Poland, between September 2 and 5. During the event, which was also attended by Deputy Minister of National Defence Bilal Durdalı, the company engaged in cooperation discussions aimed at reinforcing its global presence. One of the most prominent agenda items at MSPO 2025 was MKE’s proposal to establish a “155 mm Howitzer Ammunition Production Line” in Poland. Speaking to the press during the exhibition, Tolga Çelik, Deputy General Manager at MKE, stated that the decision-making process regarding the production line had reached its final stage and that MKE had been shortlisted with its proposal. Çelik also expressed the company’s readiness to cooperate in building the production capacity Poland requires.

 

(Left to right): Rauf Alp Denktaş, Ambassador of the Republic of Türkiye to Warsaw; Bilal Durdalı, Deputy Minister of National Defence; İlhami Keleş, General Manager of MKE.

MKE to Export 20 mm Ammunition to Poland

Following MSPO, the next stop for MKE was the DSEI 2025 exhibition in London. At this event, Poland once again took centre stage in MKE’s agenda. During the exhibition, MKE representatives held talks with officials from 43 different countries to explore potential areas of cooperation. One of the key outcomes was the conclusion of a major agreement with the Polish Air Force. Under the agreement signed at DSEI 2025, MKE will supply 20 mm ammunition for use in the cannons of Poland’s FA-50GF Fighting Eagle Block 10 light combat aircraft. In addition to this agreement with Poland, MKE representatives also signed two separate export contracts during the exhibition.

 

MKE Advances Both in Exports and Strategic Investments

MKE, which currently exports to 105 countries, is expanding its global footprint through key systems such as BORAN, the first howitzer export in the history of the Republic, and DENİZHAN, the 76/62 mm Indigenous Naval Gun. In 2024, MKE sustained its international growth with a turnover exceeding $1.2 billion.

Alongside its export achievements, MKE is progressing with large-scale domestic investments. The company is continuing work on the energetic materials plant, a project covering 4.7 million square metres. This facility ranks as the largest investment in the defence and aerospace sector and the third largest across all industries in Türkiye. In parallel, capacity expansion and new production line installations are under way at 10 factories and three facilities. Efforts have also accelerated to convert a defunct sugar factory in the Çarşamba district of Samsun into a nitroguanidine production facility. This initiative aims to meet national requirements while contributing to the local economy and social development.

A total of 323 investment projects is scheduled for implementation in 2025, with a combined value of $818 million.

contents.title_tr: CTech ve Skyline, Uydu Haberleşmesinde İş Birliği Yapacak
contents.summary_tr: TUSAŞ iştiraki CTech ile Belçikalı Skyline Communications, uydu haberleşme sistemleri ve operasyon yönetimi yazılımlarının entegrasyonuna yönelik iş birliği mutabakat zaptı imzaladı.
contents.body_tr:
17-19 Kasım tarihlerinde İzmir’de düzenlenen NATO EDGE 2026 kapsamında imzalanan anlaşmayla görev hazırlığının hızlandırılması, haberleşmenin kesintilere karşı dayanıklılığının artırılması ve operasyonel süreçlerin daha etkin yönetilmesi hedefleniyor.

İş birliği kapsamında CTech’in uydu haberleşme çözümleri, Skyline’ın yapay zekâ destekli DataMiner yazılımıyla bir araya getirilecek. Böylece haberleşme sistemlerinin görev öncesinde planlanması, kaynakların koordinasyonu ve operasyon sırasında izlenmesi ortak bir platform üzerinden gerçekleştirilebilecek. Geliştirilecek çözümlerin, farklı haberleşme seçenekleri arasında ihtiyaç hâlinde otomatik geçişi desteklemesi de öngörülüyor. Şirketler, uydu haberleşme sistemlerinin planlanması, izlenmesi ve yönetilmesine yönelik canlı bir gösterim de gerçekleştirecek.

contents.title_tr: BEST DEFENCE, UKSS Alanındaki Başarısını Yeni Alanlara Taşıyor
contents.body_tr:
Uzaktan komutalı silah sistemleri (UKSS), dünya genelinde kara araçlarının üzerinde yaygın olarak kullanılıyor. Her ne kadar bu araçlarla özdeşleşmiş hale gelmiş olsalar da UKSS’ler, kabiliyetleriyle yeni kullanım alanları da bulabiliyor. UKSS alanında geniş bir ürün yelpazesine sahip olan BEST DEFENCE, ürün ailesini; gizlenebilir UKSS’ler ve marin tip UKSS’lerle genişletiyor. Firmanın ürünleri, yenilikçi özellikleriyle son kullanıcılarına önemli avantajlar sağlamayı vadediyor.

 

BEST DEFENCE, UKSS’lerini farklı kullanım alanlarına taşıyarak bir yandan gündeme gelen yeni ihtiyaçlara çözümler getiriyor bir yandan da son kullanıcıların da yeni tanıştığı kullanım senaryolarını ortaya koyuyor. Bu UKSS’lerin operatörleri; farklı kalibrelerde silahları kullanabilme, yapay zekâ destekli hedef tespiti ve takibi, yüksek hassasiyet ve kuleyi, silahı ve mühimmatı aynı adresten tedarik edebilme gibi avantajların keyfini çıkarıyor....

contents.title_tr: KEYVAN Havacılık Verileri FlyPlan’a Entegre Edildi
contents.summary_tr: KEYVAN Havacılık’ın seyrüsefer verileri ve havacılık haritaları, Sivil Havacılık Genel Müdürlüğü (SHGM) tarafından geliştirilen FlyPlan uygulamasına entegre edildi. Uçuş planlama, harita görüntüleme ve elektronik uçuş kaydı işlemlerini tek platformda bir araya getiren uygulama, pilotların bu süreçleri dijital ortamda yürütmelerine imkân sağlıyor.
contents.body_tr: Avrupa Birliği Havacılık Emniyeti Ajansı (EASA) tarafından Tip 1 DAT veri sağlayıcısı olarak sertifikalandırılan KEYVAN Havacılık’ın verilerinin pilotların güncel havacılık bilgilerine erişimini kolaylaştırması ve uçuş öncesinde olası riskleri değerlendirmelerine katkı sağlaması hedefleniyor.

contents.title_tr: Prof. Dr. Görgün’den NATO EDGE 2026’da Ortak Üretim Çağrısı
contents.summary_tr: Savunma Sanayii Başkanı Prof. Dr. Haluk Görgün, NATO EDGE 2026’nın açılışında yaptığı konuşmada, müttefik ülkelerin savunma sanayisi alanındaki iş birliğini ve üretim kapasitesini artırması gerektiğini vurguladı. Prof. Dr. Görgün, Türkiye’nin NATO’nun savunma sanayisi alanındaki dönüşümüne katkı sağlamaya hazır olduğunu belirtti.
contents.body_tr:
NATO İletişim ve Bilgi Ajansı (NCIA) tarafından 17-19 Kasım tarihlerinde İzmir’de düzenlenen NATO EDGE 2026, ilk kez Türkiye’de gerçekleştiriliyor. NATO’nun teknoloji ve savunma sanayisi temsilcilerini buluşturan etkinliğe, 25 ülkeden 284 firma katılıyor. Türkiye ise Savunma Sanayii Başkanlığı (SSB) koordinasyonunda 30 kuruluşla etkinlikte yer alıyor.

Etkinliğin açılışında konuşan Prof. Dr. Görgün, NATO’nun değişen güvenlik ihtiyaçlarının daha hızlı karar alma süreçleri, geniş bir sanayi ekosistemi ve yüksek üretim kapasitesi gerektirdiğini söyledi. Türkiye’nin savunma ve havacılık ihracatının yüzde 56’sının NATO ülkelerine gerçekleştirildiğini belirten Görgün, Türk savunma sanayisinin İttifak’ın ortak savunma kabiliyetlerine katkı sağlamayı sürdüreceğini ifade etti.

SSB’nin 4 binin üzerinde savunma sanayisi firmasını, 110 teknoparkı ve 204 üniversiteyi kapsayan bir ekosistemi koordine ettiğini aktaran Prof. Dr. Görgün, NATO bünyesinde ortak geliştirme, üretim ve tedarik faaliyetlerinin artırılması gerektiğini vurguladı. Görgün, konuşmasını sanayi temsilcilerine seslenerek şu sözlerle tamamladı:

“Firmalarımızla tanışın. Birlikte geliştirmenin ve üretmenin yollarını arayın. Bu etkinliğin çok ötesine uzanacak ortaklıklar kurun. Gelin, daha hızlı hareket edelim, ekosistemimizi genişletelim ve birlikte daha fazla üretelim.”

contents.title_tr: Türkiye-Suudi Arabistan Savunma Sanayii Günleri’nde 601 İş Görüşmesi Gerçekleştirildi
contents.summary_tr: Türkiye ve Suudi Arabistan savunma sanayisi firmalarını bir araya getiren Türkiye-Suudi Arabistan Savunma Sanayii Günleri, 11-12 Kasım’da İstanbul’da gerçekleştirildi. Etkinliğe katılan 69 Türk ve 30 Suudi Arabistan firması, toplam 601 ikili iş görüşmesi yaptı.
contents.body_tr:
İstanbul’daki Property Expo İstanbul’da düzenlenen Türkiye-Suudi Arabistan Savunma Sanayii Günleri’nde, iki ülke arasındaki savunma sanayii iş birliklerinin geliştirilmesine yönelik görüşmeler gerçekleştirildi. Etkinlik kapsamında 11 Kasım’da 295, 12 Kasım’da ise 306 ikili iş görüşmesi yapıldı. Görüşmelerde ortak üretim, tedarik ve ihracat fırsatları değerlendirildi.

Etkinliğin 12 Kasım’da gerçekleştirilen protokol gününe, Savunma Sanayii Başkanı Prof. Dr. Haluk Görgün ve Suudi Arabistan Devlet Bakanı ve Askerî Sanayiler Genel Otoritesi (GAMI) Başkan Vekili Bandar el-Khorayef katıldı. Programda Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakan Yardımcısı Dr. Çetin Ali Dönmez, Suudi Arabistan Askerî Sanayiler Şirketi (SAMI) CEO’su Thamer AlMuhid ve DEİK Türkiye-Suudi Arabistan İş Konseyi Başkanı Haşim Süngü de yer aldı.

Etkinlik boyunca Türk savunma sanayisi firmalarıyla temaslarda bulunan el-Khorayef; Otokar, ROKETSAN, STM, HAVELSAN, TUSAŞ ve MKE yöneticileriyle görüştü. Prof. Dr. Görgün ve el-Khorayef de iki ülke arasındaki savunma sanayisi iş birliğinin geliştirilmesine yönelik ikili görüşme gerçekleştirdi.

 

Son 3,5 Yılda 75 Toplantı Gerçekleştirildi

Protokol gününde konuşan Prof. Dr. Görgün, Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan arasındaki savunma sanayisi iş birliğinin geliştirilmesine verdikleri önemi vurguladı. Son 3,5 yılda SSB tarafından Suudi Arabistan ile 75 toplantı düzenlendiğini belirten Prof. Dr. Görgün, iki ülkenin savunma sanayisi ekosistemlerini birlikte geliştirmeyi hedeflediklerini ifade etti.

Suudi Arabistan’ın 2030 Vizyonu kapsamında savunma sanayisinde yerlileştirme ve kendine yeterlilik hedeflerine değinen Prof. Dr. Görgün, Türk savunma sanayisi firmalarının bu süreçte çeşitli projeler yürüttüğünü belirtti.

Prof. Dr. Görgün, Türkiye’nin 4.500’e yaklaşan KOBİ’si, 1.400’ü aşkın projesi ve yaklaşık 120 milyar dolarlık proje portföyüyle iki ülke arasında ortak geliştirme çalışmalarını ilerletmeye hazır olduğunu söyledi.

 

Ortak Üretim ve Teknoloji İş Birliği Ön Planda

Prof. Dr. Görgün, Suudi Arabistan’ın 2030 Vizyonu doğrultusunda kurmayı hedeflediği savunma sanayisi mükemmeliyet merkezlerine de değindi. Bu merkezlere yönelik çalışmaların Türk savunma sanayii firmalarıyla değerlendirildiğini belirten Prof. Dr. Görgün, Türkiye’nin sürece katkı sağlamaya hazır olduğunu ifade etti.

İki ülke arasındaki iş birliğinin yalnızca ürün tedarikiyle sınırlı kalmaması gerektiğini vurgulayan Prof. Dr. Görgün, GAMI, SAMI ve Savunma Geliştirme Genel Otoritesi (GADD) ile yürütülen çalışmalar kapsamında KOBİ’ler arasındaki iş birliklerinin ve ileri teknoloji yatırımlarının desteklenmeye devam edeceğini söyledi.

contents.title_tr: Aziz KARAŞ, General Manager at LA2 Dynamics:
contents.title_en: Aziz KARAŞ, General Manager at LA2 Dynamics:
contents.summary_tr: “Established in 2022, LA2 Dynamics has made significant progress in a short period of time, leading to the development of SARBOT, Türkiye’s first armed legged robot.”
contents.summary_en: “Established in 2022, LA2 Dynamics has made significant progress in a short period of time, leading to the development of SARBOT, Türkiye’s first armed legged robot.”
contents.body_tr:
Legged robots, a topic that has recently come to prominence in the world of technology, have also attracted the attention of the defence industry, which has launched efforts to develop its own solutions in this field. The need for the development of new technologies and the lack of clearly defined operational concepts stand out as the main challenges currently facing legged robot programmes. Established in 2022, LA2 Dynamics, a subsidiary of SARSILMAZ Group, was founded with the sole purpose of focusing on legged robotic systems. Within a short span of time, the company succeeded in developing and finalising two different models of its first product, SARBOT, both of which have now completed their testing processes. We spoke with Aziz Karaş, General Manager at LA2 Dynamics, about the company’s progress over this brief period, the legged robotic systems it has developed, and its roadmap for the near future.

At this point, surface coating technologies emerge as an integral part of both system performance and field reliability. RGB Surface Technologies offers a strategic capability tailored to meet these rigorous demands of the defence and aerospace industries through its newly established Zinc-Nickel Plating Line....

contents.title_tr: MPT Industry for High-Precision and High-Quality Manufacturing
contents.title_en: MPT Industry for High-Precision and High-Quality Manufacturing
contents.body_tr:
In the defence and aerospace industries, the demand for manufacturing precision in system production continues to grow year by year. In the past, certain precision requirements were typically associated with aerospace and aviation platforms; however, similar standards are now increasingly being applied to land and naval systems as well. Failing to meet these demanding production criteria may adversely affect the operational success of such systems in the field. Operating in this environment, MPT Industry delivers services to the sector as a manufacturer that integrates advanced technologies into its precision machining processes and ensures consistent product quality across its output.

contents.title_tr: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / Ministry of Interior Message
contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / Ministry of Interior Message
contents.summary_tr: Security as the Foundational Basis of Peace
contents.summary_en: Security as the Foundational Basis of Peace
contents.body_tr:
The most fundamental condition for societies to endure is the preservation of peace and public tranquillity. Peace stands as the highest value of social order, political stability and collective life. Security is the principal element that enables this value to be realised. Ibn Khaldun, for his part, associates a society’s survival and the development of umrân (civilization) with the social solidarity built by asabiyyah (social cohesion); he also shows that security is the essential basis sustaining the continuity of the order established through that solidarity. In this sense, security extends beyond a mere administrative function and constitutes a fundamental basis that makes civilisational continuity possible.

Throughout history, the concept of security has been addressed in different ways and reinterpreted in line with changing conditions in every era. Preserving social order and ensuring that individuals can live in peace remain among the foremost responsibilities of public governance. When considered in light of today’s understanding of security, it becomes clear that security is no longer confined to the physical domain alone, but has evolved into a comprehensive structure encompassing digital, economic and social dimensions....

contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / Ministry of National Defence Message
contents.summary_tr: Minister of National Defence Yaşar GÜLER: “Türkiye now has a strengthened defence industry ecosystem which not only meets its own needs; but also develops and exports technology solutions, and competes on a global scale.”
contents.summary_en: Minister of National Defence Yaşar GÜLER: “Türkiye now has a strengthened defence industry ecosystem which not only meets its own needs; but also develops and exports technology solutions, and competes on a global scale.”
contents.body_tr:
Today’s global security environment has taken on a more complex, fragile and multi-layer form. Now, we have been faced to a geopolitical equation in which conventional conflicts have turned into long-term crises with a gradually enlarging diversity of threats.

In this regard, the defence understanding of states have urged to be revolutionized as hybrid threats have diversified, missile threats have increased in an environment where unmanned systems and precision-guided munitions have become more effective; energy and commerce lines as well as critical infrastructures have become targets, and cyber and space dimensions have permanently become an indispensable part of the security architecture.

Türkiye has adopted an active stance in such a multi-dimensional security environment; and has become an effectively prominent actor who enables security solutions and develops deterrent measurements by establishing a balance on a global scale....

contents.body_tr:
Dear Readers,

Türkiye’s defence and aerospace industry, with a domestic content rate exceeding 80 percent and a turnover of more than $20 billion, not only reinforces Türkiye’s security architecture but also stands as one of the driving forces behind Türkiye’s economic development through high value-added production, advanced technological capacity and rising export performance. In recent years, Türkiye has become one of the states drawing the greatest attention in the defence industry, both in its region and at the global level. In addition to meeting the needs of friendly and allied nations and contributing to global peace, Türkiye’s defence industry ranks among the sectors making substantial contributions to Türkiye in exports and employment. Defence and aerospace exports are not merely a source of foreign currency earnings; they are also among the strategic elements directly shaping Türkiye’s technological capacity, foreign policy reach and the quality of its industrial ecosystem....

Celebrating its 50th anniversary this year, Nurol Makina is exhibiting the Ejder Yalçın Ambulance, NMS EWB and NMS-L at SAHA 2026, each drawn from a product family comprising best-in-class vehicles. Known for the high mobility, superior protection, innovative solutions and modular configurations offered by its product family, Nurol Makina is demonstrating its sector leadership at SAHA.

Combining 50 years of industrial experience with innovative approaches, Nurol Makina’s product family consists of the Ejder Yalçın 4x4, NMS 4x4, NMS-L 4x4, Ilgaz 4x4, Ejder TOMA 4x4 and Ejder Kunter 4x4. Vehicles produced by Nurol Makina are in service in Türkiye and in various countries around the world....

contents.title_tr: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / SAĞLAMTEK
contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / SAĞLAMTEK
contents.summary_tr: SAĞLAMTEK Introduces Its Acoustic Drone Detection System Solution: ADTS
contents.summary_en: SAĞLAMTEK Introduces Its Acoustic Drone Detection System Solution: ADTS
contents.body_tr:
Hearing the Threat When Sight Fails

SAĞLAMTEK, known in the sector for its innovative and original solutions in global navigation satellite systems (GNSS), antennas, data links and RF components, is expanding its product family with ADTS, its acoustic drone detection system. Capable of effectively detecting drones, particularly in urban areas where other sensors may prove insufficient, ADTS helps neutralise major field threats before they materialise.

Drones, an increasingly prominent element of today’s battlefield, continue to create new challenges for air defence systems. Conventional air defence systems, which rely mainly on radar and electro-optical sensors to detect threats, may face difficulties in identifying approaching drones, especially in urban areas with structures such as buildings. Low-flying drones can also make greater use of natural obstacles, including vegetation and terrain features, than other aircraft, creating further challenges for conventional air defence systems....

contents.title_tr: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / SAHA İstanbul Message
contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / SAHA İstanbul Message
contents.summary_tr: Haluk BAYRAKTAR, Chairman of the Board of SAHA İstanbul: “SAHA 2026 Is the Global Showcase of Türkiye’s Resolve in Defence and Aerospace”
contents.summary_en: Haluk BAYRAKTAR, Chairman of the Board of SAHA İstanbul: “SAHA 2026 Is the Global Showcase of Türkiye’s Resolve in Defence and Aerospace”
contents.body_tr:
The global security architecture is no longer defined solely by military balance of power. Today, the decisive factors are technological sovereignty, manufacturing agility, supply chain resilience, data superiority, and the capacity to establish strategic partnerships. The defence and aerospace industry has moved beyond the traditional platform-based approach and has been reshaped by artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, space technologies, cybersecurity, and dual-use solutions. In this new era, Türkiye is strengthening its position not merely as an observer, but as one of the countries that develop, manufacture, export, and help shape this transformation.

Against this backdrop, we view SAHA 2026 not simply as an exhibition, but as a multidimensional platform that carries Türkiye’s defence and aerospace expertise, industrial capacity, and strategic vision to the world. To be held at the Istanbul Expo Center from May 5 to 9, SAHA 2026 will bring together more than 1,700 companies, public institutions, universities, official delegations, procurement delegations, and industry professionals across an exhibition area exceeding 100,000 square metres. In this respect, the event will be more than a venue for commercial contacts. It will also serve as a centre where defence diplomacy, technology transfer initiatives, and long-term strategic partnerships take shape....

contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / SASAD Message
contents.summary_tr: Chairman of the Board of SASAD Osman OKYAY: "The Next Phase of Transformation in the Turkish Defence and Aerospace Industry"
contents.summary_en: Chairman of the Board of SASAD Osman OKYAY: "The Next Phase of Transformation in the Turkish Defence and Aerospace Industry"
contents.body_tr:
At a time when the global security architecture is being reshaped, the defence and aerospace industry is no longer limited to military capability alone. It has become a field that directly reflects a country’s industrial strength, technological capacity, and strategic resilience. The path Türkiye has followed in recent years is part of this broader transformation.

In 2025, Türkiye’s defence and aerospace industry surpassed the threshold of 10 billion dollars in exports. This is not only a sign of growth, but also a clear indication that the sector’s position within the global system is evolving. Today, we are looking at a structure that is more integrated, more scalable, and more aligned with strategic priorities....

contents.title_tr: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / Secretariat of Defence Industries Message
contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / Secretariat of Defence Industries Message
contents.summary_tr: Prof. Dr. Haluk GÖRGÜN, Secretary of Defence Industries: “As the Secretariat of Defence Industries, we regard SAHA as a strategic platform that accelerates our export goals, expands opportunities for joint production and co-development, deepens technology partnerships, and makes our ecosystem more competitive on a global scale.”
contents.summary_en: Prof. Dr. Haluk GÖRGÜN, Secretary of Defence Industries: “As the Secretariat of Defence Industries, we regard SAHA as a strategic platform that accelerates our export goals, expands opportunities for joint production and co-development, deepens technology partnerships, and makes our ecosystem more competitive on a global scale.”
contents.body_tr:
Türkiye continues to advance its major leap in the defence industry day by day, driven by strong engineering capability, a high-technology R&D mindset, and products that have proven their value in the field. This success grows through the collective effort of a broad ecosystem—from our prime contractors to our SMEs, from our universities to our research infrastructures, and from our start-ups to every link in our supply chain. As the Secretariat of Defence Industries, we regard every step that makes this ecosystem more competitive, more resilient, and more sustainable as a strategic priority, and we strengthen our vision of domestic and national production with unwavering determination.

In this context, clusters stand out as powerful platforms that go beyond expanding production; they accelerate cooperation, co-development, supply networks, and international outreach. The dynamism brought to our sector by the SAHA Istanbul Defence, Aerospace and Space Cluster makes a significant contribution to bringing our stakeholders together around shared goals and positioning them more visibly and more effectively on a global scale.

One of the key gatherings where this approach will be showcased at its strongest is SAHA 2026, the International Defence and Aerospace Exhibition, which will take place on 5–9 May 2026, hosted by the Istanbul Expo Center....

STEST’s ability to provide a wide range of testing services from a single source, together with the national and international validity of these services, makes the company one of the sector’s leading testing solutions partners....

contents.title_en: SAHA 2026 SPECIAL ISSUE / YALTES
contents.summary_tr: YALTES Emerges as a Key Actor in Naval Modernisation Projects
contents.summary_en: YALTES Emerges as a Key Actor in Naval Modernisation Projects
contents.body_tr:
YALTES, a stakeholder in numerous new shipbuilding programmes both in Türkiye and worldwide, continues to expand its business in modernisation projects. Leveraging its extensive expertise in combat management systems (CMS) and integrated platform control and monitoring systems (IPMS), the company plays active roles in major modernisation efforts across domestic and international markets. YALTES’ capabilities in CMS and IPMS enable the delivery of solutions that meet both technical requirements and platform-specific constraints, which is particularly critical in modernisation projects where identifying the optimum solution is essential. This approach consistently leads to outcomes that satisfy end-user expectations. The company’s continuously advancing expertise further positions it as a strong contributor to major programmes such as MUGEM, TF-2000 and MİLDEN in Türkiye.

Modernisation activities conducted on in-service platforms present a range of challenges when compared to new-build projects, particularly in technical, scheduling and cost-related aspects....

contents.title_tr: SAR 127 MT Boosts the ALTAY Tank’s Combat Capability
contents.title_en: SAR 127 MT Boosts the ALTAY Tank’s Combat Capability
contents.summary_tr: Enhancing the Firepower of Tanks and Armoured Vehicles on the Modern Battlefield
contents.summary_en: Enhancing the Firepower of Tanks and Armoured Vehicles on the Modern Battlefield
contents.body_tr:
SAR 127 MT, which is part of the product portfolio of SARSILMAZ – a leading company in Türkiye’s defence industry – is now operational aboard the ALTAY main battle tank. Having successfully completed its qualification processes and been deployed in various projects, the system is now fully integrated into the ALTAY tank and ready for active field duty. The weapon, mounted on the tank’s remote controlled weapon station (RCWS), delivers effective firepower against both ground and aerial targets. In addition to its firepower, SAR 127 MT also offers design features that facilitate its integration into RCWS platforms. These features are among the key advantages that paved the way for its deployment aboard ALTAY.

 

The first ALTAY tanks to roll off the new serial production line have been delivered to the Turkish Armed Forces (TAF), each equipped with the SAR 127 MT heavy machine gun mounted on their RCWS. Due to the significance of this delivery, a ceremony was held on October 28 at the BMC Production Facilities for Tanks and Next-Generation Armoured Vehicles in Ankara, with the attendance of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan. The SAR 127 MT will be installed on all 250 ALTAY tanks ordered for the TAF....

contents.title_tr: Vefa Kuzu, Chairman of ARMSTO:
contents.title_en: Vefa Kuzu, Chairman of ARMSTO:
contents.summary_tr: “A large majority of the platforms and systems developed by the Turkish defence and aerospace industry in recent years incorporate connectors that we have designed and manufactured.”
contents.summary_en: “A large majority of the platforms and systems developed by the Turkish defence and aerospace industry in recent years incorporate connectors that we have designed and manufactured.”
contents.body_tr:
ARMSTO is preparing to close 2025, the year it commenced mass production of connectors that successfully passed all customer qualification tests, having delivered more than 200,000 units and secured a market share of up to 15 percent in the Türkiye market. Following these achievements in its first year of serial production, ARMSTO is now focusing on increasing production volumes and market share, while pursuing opportunities in export markets. Vefa Kuzu, Chairman of ARMSTO, describes 2026 as the year in which the company will have “started walking,” while also setting out an ambitious vision for what it aims to achieve once it begins to “run.” Kuzu shared ARMSTO’s journey towards serial production and the company’s plans for 2026 with readers of MSI Turkish Defence Review.

 ...
